This directly establishes participant awareness for the approved assignment comparison.

The report documents a single HFNC participant who did not receive assigned preoxygenation because no device was available, but neither it nor the inspected protocol passage establishes that this was caused by research context rather than ordinary logistical delivery, or whether conduct violated the protocol. Thus no affirmative context-caused protocol-inconsistent deviation is established and no negative judgment is warranted.
unknowns: Whether the unavailable HFNC device and nonreceipt violated protocol and arose because of trial context rather than ordinary delivery circumstances; whether any other context-caused deviations occurred.
